Balak arrived and set up mangonels against the fortress and captured it,
and they killed seventy Frankish and Armenian men.
And he captured King Baldwin and Waleran, his sister's son,
and went and encamped against Mabbug.
And while he was fighting against it,
he was struck by an arrow from the wall,
and died.
And his forces fled to Aleppo,
and they set up as their leader his cousin named Timurtash.
And he sold the king and his sister's son for one hundred thousand dinars,
and King Baldwin returned to Jerusalem.
And over the fortress of Zaid, Sulayman likewise took control, from the family of Balak.
And the Sultan of Melitene took Massara and Gargar.
And a great star was seen,
its length from south to north,
and its width like a horse's neck,
and it continued to be seen for two months.
And in the year 1435 [1124 AD],
1435 of the Greeks, 518 {AH},
in Haziran (June), on a Friday,
Amir Ghazi, the son of Danishmend, lord of Sebastia, attacked Melitene,
and plundered the whole region,
and besieged the city for one month.
Then he left his son Muhammad in Saman, a large village, with a large force,
and ordered them to attack its gates every day,
and not allow anyone to enter or go out.
Now 'Arab,
because he used to go out at all times and plunder the territory of Danishmend like a brigand,
was not present in the city.
Then the city was distressed by severe famine,
for one qafiz of wheat, that is, a donkey's load, was sold for thirty-six gold dinars.
And finally sustenance was completely exhausted,
and people began soaking untanned hides and the bindings of books and shoes, and boiling and eating them.
As for cats and dogs,
or a donkey, even if dead,
where were they to be found? For with three bitter scourges was the pitiable city smitten:
the sword from outside,
which was destroying everyone who fled;
and the famine that was consuming from within;
and the second Jezebel, the mother of the Sultan,
who had escaped from Mosul,
who was torturing the freeborn for the sake of gold,
so that she might deliver herself and flee,
and was prepared even to kill the entire populace,
and then go out.
And stars were seen falling from heaven.
Then the Lord took pity
